example.title: 鳜幼鱼饲料中最适淀粉添加量研究

extract.quote: 当饲料淀粉含量超过13% 时，鳜血糖水平显著升高，血清中谷草转氨酶和谷丙转氨酶活性显著上升，肝组织空泡化程度加重，出现核聚集甚至核溶解现象。
extract.statement: 当饲料淀粉含量超过13%时，鳜的血糖水平升高，血清转氨酶活性上升，且肝组织出现空泡化、核聚集及核溶解等病理变化。

map.reason: The statement reports physiological and pathological changes (elevated blood glucose, liver enzyme activity, and histological damage like vacuolization and nuclear dissolution) resulting from high dietary starch. These are direct indicators of metabolic stress and liver pathology, which are welfare-relevant health issues. The study measures these negative outcomes directly.

verify.note: 该陈述与引文内容一致：饲料淀粉含量超过13%时血糖升高、血清转氨酶活性上升、肝组织空泡化及核聚集、核溶解等变化均在引文中明确出现。

render.text_en: When the dietary starch content exceeds 13%, blood glucose levels in mandarin fish increase, serum transaminase activity rises, and pathological changes such as vacuolization, nuclear aggregation, and karyolysis appear in liver tissue.

after: 不同碳水化合物水平饲料

names: diets with different lipid and carbohydrate levels
name: dietary carbohydrate level
饲料碳水化合物水平
cluster.reason: All members are different carbohydrate inclusion levels (13%, 16.5%, 9.7%, 20-30%, optimum) of the same practice, dietary carbohydrate level, so none need dropping.

findings.statement_en: In mandarin fish, higher dietary carbohydrate mostly harmed health: several papers measured liver damage (vacuolization, lipid build-up, raised MDA and liver enzymes, apoptosis and ER stress) once levels passed about 7-13%, with the interaction with high fat making it worse. One paper found that carbohydrate improved growth and, in saline-alkaline water, a 13% diet eased the oxidative and tissue damage, and a medium level raised plasma immune-related proteins.
findings.statement_zh: 在鳜上，饲料碳水化合物偏高多数情况下对健康不利：多篇研究测到，碳水超过约7%～13%后肝细胞肿胀空泡化、脂质蓄积、MDA和转氨酶升高、细胞凋亡和内质网应激，与高脂叠加时更严重。也有研究发现碳水能促生长，在盐碱水中13%碳水饲料可减轻氧化和组织损伤，中等水平还提高了血浆免疫相关蛋白。

grouping.reason: All members are different carbohydrate inclusion levels (13%, 16.5%, 9.7%, 20-30%, optimum) of the same practice, dietary carbohydrate level, so none need dropping.

strength.en: Of 87 claims that take a side: 7 in favour, 80 against or no effect. At least 80% point one way.
strength.zh: 87 条有明确倾向的论断中，7 条支持，80 条反对或无效果，至少 80% 指向同一方向。
strength.rule: one paper; described if more claims describe than take a side; agree or against at 80% or more one way; otherwise mixed

basis.summary: Most weight goes to measured claims on liver histology, MDA, enzymes and apoptosis from several mandarin fish papers (S454, S461, S055, S503, S018), which agree on harm at high carbohydrate; I noted the supportive claims from S053, S090 and S114 as exceptions under specific conditions and left out background and other-species claims.

actions.action_en: Keep dietary carbohydrate and starch in mandarin fish feeds at about 10-13% and avoid formulating above roughly 13-16%.
actions.action_zh: 饲料厂应将鳜鱼饲料中的碳水化合物和淀粉控制在约10-13%,避免配方超过约13-16%。

priority.reason: Many measured papers (51 measured claims in F0535 alone) show liver damage and reduced feed intake from high carbohydrate, so capping it is a clear feed-formulation step. Thresholds vary between 7 and 16%, which keeps it just below the top.

criteria.note: liver damage and anorexia, all fed fish
slightly lower growth if too low

actions.evidence_gap: Reported thresholds differ between studies (about 7-16%), and effects with different fish sizes, fat levels and water types are not settled.
actions.risks: Going too low may cut protein sparing and growth, and one study found carbohydrate improved growth and, in saline-alkaline water, a 13% diet eased tissue damage.

basis.reason: These four findings all measured harm from high carbohydrate or starch in mandarin fish, covering liver damage, lower feed intake and anorexia, and they give similar cut-off levels. I chose them over the sugar and gelatinized starch findings because they rest on more papers and more measured results. The type is avoid for high levels only, because the safe level is not fixed and low-to-moderate levels sometimes showed no effect.

findings.why: Measured liver damage once carbohydrate passed about 7-13%
Lower intake and anorexia at high levels; best around 10-13%
Liver damage and higher AST/ALT above about 13-16% starch
High-sugar diets lowered intake and growth; only some fish became anorexic
